mechanisms.mechanism: The fields of a record are joined with spaces before they are hashed, so a space in a name or in the destination of a link can move from one field to the next without changing the text. Two different sets of links then give the same records, and a link that is pointed elsewhere can go unnoticed.
mechanisms.trigger: Untracked links `a` to `b c d`, `a b` to `c d`, and `a b c` to `e`; then `a` is pointed at `b c e`.
mechanisms.why_severity: A probable gap that needs unusual names.
